description: This file defines the abstract superclass 'AbstractPersistenceOperationsActor' for Akka actors managing persistence operations related to namespaces and entity types within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles subscription to pub-sub commands, and includes methods for purging namespaces and entities, managing shutdown procedures, and scheduling tasks.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceOperationsActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor base class responsible for handling namespace and entity persistence operations in Eclipse Ditto, including pub-sub subscriptions, purge commands, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Subscribes the actor to namespace and entity command topics on startup.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Closes resources and cleans up when the actor stops.

methods.name: subscribeForNamespaceCommands
methods.description: Subscribes to namespace-related commands via pub-sub.

methods.name: subscribeForEntitiesCommands
methods.description: Subscribes to entity-related commands via pub-sub.

methods.name: getSubscribeGroup
methods.description: Returns the subscription group identifier based on the actor's path.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handlers for various command types such as purge commands and subscription acknowledgments.

methods.name: purgeNamespace
methods.description: Handles namespace purge requests, invoking namespaceOps.purge and responding with success or failure.

methods.name: purgeEntities
methods.description: Handles entity purge requests, including scheduling and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: shutDownPersistenceActorsOfEntitiesToPurge
methods.description: Publishes a shutdown message for entities to be purged.

methods.name: schedulePurgingEntitiesIn
methods.description: Schedules the actual purging of entities after a delay.

methods.name: doPurgeEntities
methods.description: Executes the entity purge operation and responds with the result.

methods.name: handleSubscribeAck
methods.description: Logs acknowledgment of subscription to pub-sub topics.
